form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this schedule, shown in the list of schedules.
Whether this schedule runs. It can only be enabled when its processing node exists and an error feed is set on the rule or report, or as the default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Needs an existing node and an error feed to be enabled.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Node
form:FormGroup.helpText: Node that runs this schedule; it never runs on any other node. New schedules start with the default node, and administrators can select Set Default to change the default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: This schedule only runs on the selected node.

form:FormGroup.label: Schedule
form:FormGroup.helpText: When the process runs: Instant, Cron or Frequency. Select it to open the schedule editor. Running every minute or more often is not allowed.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Opens the schedule editor. Must run less often than once a minute.

form:FormGroup.label: Start Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Effective time of the first run, as an ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. If it is in the past, the missed runs are made in turn. It has no effect once the schedule has run, and is not used for Instant schedules.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: ISO 8601 date and time. Past times make the missed runs.

form:FormGroup.label: End Time (Optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: No runs are made with an effective time after this. Enter an ISO 8601 date and time, or leave blank for no end.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: ISO 8601 date and time. Leave blank for no end.

form:FormGroup.label: Run As User
form:FormGroup.helpText: User whose permissions the schedule runs with. You can only choose users you are allowed to run as. Default is you.
